name: v10-r1-consolidate
note: V10 R1, the cheapest informative run (PLAN.md): C2 reproduces only 26/40 of its own programs and 32/60 held-out combinations, and its gains are held-out items made of grammar parts. Does more exposure to the same grammar, with new examples, consolidate it? From C2 (init_from; C2's optimizer state no longer exists, so Lion starts fresh): 2 new examples per C2 program (data seed 1302 via data_seed_offset 1: other prompt templates and another replay sample), 50% replay, one epoch (36 steps), lr 1e-4 WSD (2 warmup steps, stable 80%, cosine to 1e-5), seed 1301. One change against C2: more training on C2's curriculum.
decision: PLAN.md: selection on dev, unseen-v1, combined /97 and family_new; second seed if combined >= 32 and no failure category loses >= 3 of round 54's items. The benchmark, neighbours, held-out families, reproduction and held-out combinations are reported.
